notes: Use aoa-adr-write when the task is to capture a concrete architectural or workflow decision.
Use aoa-source-of-truth-check when the task is to identify which documents are authoritative and reduce overlap.
Use aoa-decision when the task needs a decision-lane route through find, create, or correct.
Use aoa-decision-find when prior decision rationale should be located and source-verified.
Use aoa-decision-create when a new repo-local decision record must be written.
Use aoa-decision-correct when an existing decision record, index, status, or graph mismatch must be repaired.
aoa-bounded-context-map is about naming contexts and interfaces at the system or domain level.
aoa-core-logic-boundary is about separating reusable rules from glue or orchestration.
aoa-port-adapter-refactor is about isolating a concrete dependency behind a port or adapter.
aoa-change-protocol is the generic bounded-change workflow.
aoa-commit-growth-seam is the narrower post-verify commit boundary when the coding work is already done.
aoa-tdd-slice is specifically test-first feature slicing.
aoa-contract-test is specifically about validating a module/service/workflow boundary.
aoa-property-invariants authors new invariant or property checks.
aoa-invariant-coverage-audit inspects whether current tests already prove the relevant invariants.
aoa-session-donor-harvest is the post-session nucleus: it authors a bounded HARVEST_PACKET and names the next honest family handoff.
aoa-checkpoint-closeout-bridge turns checkpoint-led shortlist hints into one explicit reviewed-closeout chain without letting provisional notes become final authority.

aoa-memo-writeback routes session evidence and landed-work context toward a local memo candidate, reviewed-intake export, or explicit no-writeback stop line without making raw session history reviewed memory.

aoa-automation-opportunity-scan classifies whether a recurring reviewed route should stay manual, become a bounded skill, or become a playbook automation seed without granting scheduler or background authority.
aoa-session-route-forks makes several plausible next routes legible when continuation should stay branch-aware instead of hidden in one recommendation.
aoa-session-self-diagnose turns repeated friction, drift, or proof blur from reviewed evidence into a diagnosis packet before mutation.
aoa-session-self-repair turns an existing reviewed diagnosis into the smallest honest repair packet with checkpoint posture and rollback thinking.
aoa-session-progression-lift reflects reviewed mastery movement as a bounded multi-axis delta without pretending to be routing or role authority.
aoa-quest-harvest stays the narrow final promotion verdict once the material is already reduced to one repeated reviewed quest unit.
aoa-eval is the front door for choosing an eval-lane route across existing evals, local ports, validators, tests, scripts, MCP access packets, and session-derived trigger pressure.
aoa-eval-select inspects existing local and central eval surfaces before new work.
aoa-eval-apply runs or routes an already selected eval surface and reports proof limits.
aoa-eval-local-need records bounded repo-local eval pressure under evals/intake when no existing surface fits.
aoa-eval-design drafts local eval suites or reports after selection fails without claiming central proof acceptance.
aoa-eval-session-mining mines .aoa only for candidate eval triggers after web and repo gates; raw session refs are not reviewed proof.
aoa-contract-test, aoa-property-invariants, and aoa-invariant-coverage-audit stay focused on test/invariant authoring or audit when no eval-lane owner route is in question.
aoa-source-of-truth-check, aoa-memo-writeback, and aoa-decision win when the pressure is documentation authority, memory writeback, or decision graph routing rather than eval proof routing.
aoa-summon decides whether one anchored parent route may launch a bounded child helper and what lane, gates, and return posture apply.
aoa-session-route-forks is broader next-route comparison when several plausible continuations need to stay visible.
aoa-checkpoint-closeout-bridge coordinates reviewed closeout order from checkpoint hints rather than child-route delegation during the live route.
aoa-change-protocol is about doing the bounded work directly instead of selecting a child route to do it.
aoa-approval-gate-check classifies risk and whether execution is allowed at all.
aoa-dry-run-first insists on preview or simulation before a real mutation.
aoa-safe-infra-change handles bounded infra or config changes with rollback thinking.
aoa-local-stack-bringup is the local multi-service stack start path and is explicit-only.
aoa-sanitized-share is about turning raw technical material into a safe public artifact.
Use a project overlay only when the repository actually matches that overlay family and the repo-relative adaptation matters.
Current live overlay families here are the atm10-* and abyss-* repo-local exemplars.
Use the base AoA skill when the workflow does not need a thin project overlay.
Use os-abyss-artifact-trust-loop when ABI, provenance, signatures, SBOM, C2PA, durable evidence, drift, registry latest, or trust-gate verdicts determine whether an OS Abyss artifact can be consumed.
Use aoa-eval when the question is proof-surface selection or running an eval rather than artifact admission.
Use aoa-source-of-truth-check when the question is which owner files are authoritative before artifact policy is inspected.
Use aoa-approval-gate-check or abyss-safe-infra-change when the pressure is execution permission or bounded infrastructure mutation without an artifact-trust read model.
Titan scaffold skills are explicit-only project overlays for summon, receipts, gates, console, bridge, replay, and candidate memory.
